title: R3 — discriminação conjunta H0DN × BG1 com nulo exato e compatibilidade TGL
scientific_question: Does the frozen H0DN × BG1 network reject the zero local/background log-H offset at one-sided five sigma while remaining compatible with the frozen TGL shift at bilateral 95%?

primary_rule.compatibility_gradient: Separate grad(logH+logK), preserving its covariance with grad(logH), as in frozen R2

secondary_rule.role: Diagnostic only; cannot overturn, replace or improve the primary verdict

exact_background.physical_model: Gaussian H0 from pinned BG1; no clipping, redraw or fitting
exact_background.threshold_method: Numerically integrate the exact physical-H0 background tail and solve q so the marginal null tail equals null_alpha

r2_reference_only.warning: Reference values are not R3 thresholds and must not be reused after covariance changes

verdicts.DISCRIMINATED_NULL_AND_COMPATIBLE_TGL_AT: Primary joint rule passes, all covariance/systematic gates pass, and route-selection accounting is valid. One determination only, not final physical confirmation.
verdicts.NULL_REJECTED_BUT_NOT_DISCRIMINATED: Primary exact null rule passes but abs(z_tgl) exceeds compatibility_halfwidth.
verdicts.TGL_COMPATIBLE_NULL_NOT_REJECTED: Primary exact null rule does not pass and abs(z_tgl) is within compatibility_halfwidth; report power and never upgrade to detection.
verdicts.NOT_DISCRIMINATED: Primary exact null rule does not pass and abs(z_tgl) exceeds compatibility_halfwidth.
verdicts.INCONCLUSIVE_SYSTEMATICS: A required covariance, custody, support, calibration or prespecified physical-sensitivity condition fails or reverses the verdict.
verdicts.EXPLORATORY_ONLY: Route-selection or cross-route multiplicity accounting is not adequate for confirmatory use.

power_gate.if_below_gate: No confirmatory opening. A separately labelled diagnostic opening requires operator decision and can never yield DISCRIMINATED_NULL_AND_COMPATIBLE_TGL_AT_5SIGMA.

linear_planning_reference.status: Planning only; recompute exactly after covariance closure; no such external measurement is asserted

required_gates.requirement: Recover and independently validate the light-curve-to-55-row aggregation operator, including all 26 multi-curve calibrators, with source pins and numerical fixtures.
Resolve eight absent IDs and validate or reject the two candidate aliases by primary sources before outcomes; no name-similarity guessing.
Separate SN-only, Cepheid-host and peculiar-velocity components; demonstrate no duplicated Cepheid, SN or velocity information.
Freeze full joint covariance, verify PSD/support/rank and design columns, reject substantive negative eigenvalues, ambiguous rank, diagonalization and ridge fixes.
Freeze route-selection and cross-route multiplicity accounting or an independent reserved confirmation; retrospective best-route selection is prohibited.
Recompute exact background thresholds and verify the marginal and joint null tails analytically and by importance sampling with relative standard error <= 0.01.
Reach primary exact joint power >= 0.90 under the frozen physical covariance and all required robustness models.
Independent review of covariance, aggregation, estimator, route selection, power and refusal guards by an agent that did not construct them.
New R3 seeds and scores after covariance closure; hash scores before labels; independent acknowledgment before unblinding; one observed opening only.
Identify and preregister the second autonomous determination with independent systematics before any claim beyond one determination.

prespecified_sensitivity.status: Stress coordinates inherited from R2, not measured priors
prespecified_sensitivity.physical_cross_covariance: Must be estimated or bounded by admitted primary-source evidence before R3 trials; adversarial signs are sensitivity only, never a falsification or model-selection device
prespecified_sensitivity.verdict_conflict: Any verdict reversal across physically admitted and prespecified sensitivity models yields INCONCLUSIVE_SYSTEMATICS

forbidden_post_unblinding_changes: external Cepheid prior or power target
trial exclusion, loss handling or observed-fit rule
selection of the most favorable model or sensitivity
